name: hcportal_generateWebAdminToken
description: Generates a short-lived one-time token (10 min) that the Flutter portal passes to the Next.js public-web admin UI as ?token=. The browser redeems it via publicWeb_redeemAdminToken to obtain the hc_admin_session cookie. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (device-bound token, NULL callerParamString). Permission gate: the caller's non-removed HC.HasherKennelMap row for the kennel (resolved from KennelUniqueShortName, deleted=0, removed=0) must carry any of authIsAdmin (0x00000001), authCanManagePublicWebContent (0x00000080) or authIsSuperAdmin (0x40000000) in AppAccessFlags (mask 0x40000081). Expired tokens are purged and the new token inserted inside one transaction.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Portal device ID — passed to ValidatePortalAuth for authentication

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived device token for this SP name — passed to ValidatePortalAuth

parameters.name: kennelSlug
parameters.description: Required. URL slug (Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName) of the kennel whose website the admin wants to edit; stored on the token row as PublicWebAdminToken.KennelSlug. NULL/empty returns 'kennelSlug is required.'
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is NVARCHAR(100); Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName is NVARCHAR(50). Matches PublicWebAdminToken.KennelSlug NVARCHAR(100). Wider than the lookup column, so no data loss.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of TokenResult on auth failure, missing kennelSlug, kennel not found, missing admin rights ('You do not have admin access to this kennel website.'), or a runtime error from the CATCH block.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error text (NVARCHAR(255) from ValidatePortalAuth), validation message, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block

rowsets.name: TokenResult
rowsets.description: Returned on success — one row containing the lowercase UUID token to pass in the redirect URL.

columns.name: Token
columns.description: LOWER(CAST(id AS NVARCHAR(36))) of the new HC.PublicWebAdminToken row — valid for 10 minutes, single use. Lowercase because Next.js compares with LOWER().

sideEffects: In one transaction: DELETE FROM HC.PublicWebAdminToken WHERE ExpiresAt < SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() (purge of expired tokens)

In the same transaction: INSERT HC.PublicWebAdminToken (Id, HasherId, KennelSlug, ExpiresAt = now + 10 min). Table defined in db/hc6/public-web/archive/add_publicwebadmintoken.sql (not in db/schema/tables).

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH block (line 89) returns the Success=0 envelope with ERROR_MESSAGE() but writes no HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure (timeout, deadlock) is invisible server-side unless the API shim logs it. CLAUDE.md: every CATCH must log to HC.ErrorLog.

codeSmells.issue: Admin lookup does not require a single HKM row
codeSmells.detail: Lines 59-64 assign @HasAdminRights from a SELECT over HasherKennelMap; if duplicate non-removed rows existed the last row read wins. Harmless while (UserId, KennelId) stays unique.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove the Token column from the success rowset
Never change the token lifetime without updating the Next.js session cookie maxAge
Never change the permission mask (0x40000081) without updating all callers
